text:
maya: bringing up Gemma-7B int4 on dedicated pool. quick smoke shows token alignment oddness with longctx (>=2k).

sam: can you paste sample? :eyes:

maya: here's minimal repro:
```
input = 'The quick brown fox jumps'
out_host = host_run(input, model='gemma-7b-int4', max_len=2048)
out_local = local_run(input, model='gemma-7b-fp16')
print(out_host[:120])
```
output_host: 'The quick brown fox jumps\n\n### Answer:' -> gets doubled sentinel
output_local: 'The quick brown fox jumps' (no sentinel)

liam: sentinel duplication smells like tokenizer vocab mismatch or kv cache offset when wrapping. did conversion use byte-level or legacy tokenizer?

maya: conversion used our standard converter (vocab merge) + rotary headwise quant shim. tokenizer hash looks identical but token ids diverge around 256-260.

nina: could be a pad/sentinel aliasing at high token ids. Also saw similar with Mistral->Llama bridges where eos idx moved. quick check: `tokenizer.decode([255,256,257,258])` -> returns weird control chars.

maya: ran quick scan: found two entries mapping to 256 in new vocab (duplicate)

ops-bot: import-alert: model-upload gemma-7b-int4 completed. checks: checksum ok, conversion warnings: 1 duplicate-token-id

liam: duplicate-token-id explains duplicate sentinel. fix options: remap high ids, rerun converter with 'merge_strategy=prefer_new' or reindex.

sam: before redoing conversion can we try overlaying a token-id remap at runtime? patch kvcache index offset by -1 for ids>=256 and see if outputs align.

maya: did quick hack — patched kvcache index and ran smoke. duplication gone but small logit shift at punctuation.

nina: logit shifts expected with int4 quant + remapping. need quality eval on eval-set. run rouge/bleu+longctx pass.

maya: kicking off batch, added eval job 1717700000-ev with 500 prompts incl. long-context and instruction-following. I'll post results.

sam: also try disabling rotary headwise scaling in runtime (set ROTARY_SCALE=1.0) — we've seen headwise multipliers amplify aliasing.

maya: good call. tried scale=1.0 — punctuation logit shift reduced, but generation slightly slower. collecting metrics.

liam: action items: 1) fix vocab duplicate in converter. 2) run remap+eval as stopgap. 3) add converter check for duplicate token ids and fail. 4) add rotatory-scale toggle to nightly smoke.

maya: adding tasks to triage board. thanks all :heart:

sam: nice, can we tag customer impacted? none yet, internal only.

maya: yep internal only. will keep in eng-ml channel for visibility.
